GaN TIM Digital Twin

Top-side-cooled GaN power package, 25 °C ambient. Pick a commercial Parker THERM-A-GAP pad, a stock thickness and an assembly pressure, then the operating point (power, cooling, die power map) and the assembly quality (coverage); the field, thermal resistances, allowable power and reliability-risk indicators update instantly from surrogate models trained on finite-element results. Demo only; simulation-based, indicative values.

EPTC 2026 Student Innovation Challenge Author: Dinh Phong Nguyen · Vietnam
